resource_note: Both engines use two search threads and USI pondering; up to four search threads may run concurrently on a lane. CPU-seconds and energy were not measured. This is not a single-thread or ponder-disabled comparison.
timing_note: Wall time includes reconstruction and USI I/O; depths/nodes in different game positions are descriptive, not controlled speed comparisons.
storage: Actual played archive and binaries/report preserved in the named data Release package with verified readback SHA256; raw PVs remain temporary Actions artifacts.

excluding_original_corpus.note: Conservative descriptive subset excluding every complete move sequence in the original 1000-game corpus. Does not change prespecified selection on all scheduled games.

learning_distribution.definition: Average outcome score of the side to move, equal weight per game within each selected subset. Descriptive label audit only, not a causal or strength test.
